name: Nanbu Iori
source:
She was a senpai that the protagonist had a crush on in high school. Now, for some reason, she's the protagonist's step sister...

She can get a little naughty when she drinks, but usually she's a kind older sister.

[Adapted from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/ichaane/character222.html]official website[/url]]
